newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Yeltsin leaves for Ukraine visit - Tass.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Yeltsin leaves for Ukraine visit - Tass.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin left Moscow on Friday for a long awaited visit to Ukraine where he aims to improve troubled relations with the neighbouring Slav state by signing a friendship and cooperation treaty.
"Russian President Boris Yeltsin left today (Friday) for a two-day state visit to Kiev," Russia's Itar Tass news agency said.
Interfax news agency earlier quoted Yeltsin's spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky as saying: "(It is) the most difficult visit and the most important foreign policy act by the Russian President in 1997."
